converter: scripts/warehouse-usd-to-glb-v2.py (R1 successor of warehouse-section-usd-to-glb.py; same triangulation/bounds contract)
materialMode: splits+uv, replacement factors (UDIM source textures cannot be expressed in glTF; 23,079,906 B at pinned revision, not embedded)
preservedFromSource: face-varying st as TEXCOORD_0 (V flipped to glTF)
per-face material splits (GeomSubset materialBind + mesh binding)
UsdPreviewSurface texture roles where embedded (Albedo sRGB, ORM G/B = roughness/metallic, Normal)
discardedFeatures: UDIM texture set (T_Rack_A1_*.1001-1003.png) not embedded: glTF has no UDIM addressing; UVs are preserved so a future tiled split remains possible
Per-material PBR factors are documented replacements in scripts/warehouse-r1-materials.json
fallback: Renderer keeps the verified v1 GLB as fallback: if a v2 derivative fails to load, OperationsView falls back per-asset and reports it in Developer diagnostics (never a silent proxy).
